instruction_summary: Build a leave-Hansen-out model of which DUI sanction margins deter, predict Hansen's 0.08/0.15 margins out of sample, compare with the 001 methods re-analysis, and make falsifiable predictions.

steps.description: Read completed methods-and-transport (001-equivalent) results from disk; verify gate1 (card completed) and gate2 (bin means 0.1043/0.1241)
Verify sha256 of all staged literature/utah/nhtsa inputs against PROVENANCE (gate2)
Write T0 Hansen codes + T2 non-Hansen margin codes BEFORE the fit (gate4)
Fit sign model (all rows) + descriptive regression (n=7<8); T1 harmonisation
T3-H out-of-sample prediction + classification of Hansen's margins
T4 re-analysed elasticities + labelled jail-day upper bounds; T5 Utah .05 shares

key_results.sign_model_record_change: splits by domain: DUI deters (Sloan -6.6/-24.5%), general crime criminogenic (Agan +113%, Mueller-Smith-Schnepel +100%)
key_results.answer_to_requester: The newer prosecution/jail studies do NOT contradict Hansen; they identify a record/stigma channel in general crime, distinct from Hansen's experienced-severity DUI margins.

comparison_to_original.note: strict coding ~100% survives; statutory ~66% (attenuates, CI incl 0)
sign consistent with leave-Hansen-out model prediction (deter)

comparison_to_original.followup: DUI record deters (Sloan); general-crime record criminogenic (Agan/Mueller-Smith)
comparison_to_original.note: domain split explains the apparent contradiction with newer studies

deviations: Part II spec reads followup/001-methods-and-transport/results/, which is EMPTY (001 cut short); used the completed continuation study followup/002-methods-and-transport (result_card status=completed) as the 001 input.
